# Scientific review

**Correctness: PASS.** The universal coefficient presentation follows from the relations on the two free generators and the invertibility of the linear coefficient matrix modulo the nilpotent ideal generated by the constants. Explicit matrices prove the identification of the reduced image with the line parabolic and show an isomorphism of eight-dimensional tangent Lie algebras; the argument is independent of finite enumeration.

**Originality: PASS (bounded comparison, residual risk).** Premet identifies the abstract Witt algebra with \(\mathfrak{sl}_3\), and Boos studies classical parabolic conjugation. Neither inspected material gives the coordinate ring of the full nonreduced automorphism group scheme together with an isomorphism on tangent Lie algebras despite its proper reduced image. Comparisons with a different non-smooth characteristic-two Leibniz automorphism scheme do not imply the present fact. Boos's full paper was not available to inspect; general automorphism-scheme literature could overlap and absolute priority is not certified.

**Value: PASS.** This isolates an actual failure of smoothness: two infinitesimal translation directions appear in the Lie algebra but not in any geometric-point automorphism. The resulting infinitesimally full yet pointwise proper group-scheme map reconciles two different symmetry notions for the exceptional characteristic-two Witt algebra, and is more informative than the elementary rational-point group order.

Independent verification has not been performed. Finite tests substantiate, but do not replace, the universal proof.

Self-review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
